provider: US EPA (Fifth Unregulated Contaminant Monitoring Rule)
variables_we_need: PWSID, PWS name, size, facility water type, sample point, collection date, contaminant, MRL, result sign (</=), result value, sample event, EPA region, state
notes: 29 PFAS + lithium; ~2.0M analyte-result rows nationally; ~226k for Texas. EPA re-posts updated files ~quarterly through 2026 - re-run download_raw.sh to refresh.
One row per PWS-ZIP pair. This is a list of ZIPs in the service area, NOT a boundary and NOT population-weighted.

variables_we_need: PFAS occurrence flag, potential PFAS sources, treatment information
notes: Self-reported utility responses; used descriptively only.

provider: CDC Division of Population Health / RWJF
variables_we_need: ZCTA, measure id (OBESITY/DIABETES/BPHIGH), crude prevalence, 95% CI, total population, adult population
notes: Model-based small-area estimates from BRFSS 2023 + ACS 2019-2023 + 2020 census population. 29,983 ZCTAs nationally; crude prevalence only at ZCTA scale. NOT direct measurements; not for program evaluation.

geographic_scale: multiple; we extract ZCTA5 (2020 vintage) rows
variables_we_need: B01001 age/sex, B01003 total pop, B03002 race/ethnicity, B15003 education, B17001 poverty, B19013 median HH income, B23025 employment, B25003 tenure, B25024 units in structure, B25064 gross rent, B25077 home value
access_method: Direct file download (.dat pipe-delimited) filtered to ZCTA rows
notes: Keyless alternative to the Census Data API / tidycensus (which now require a key). Estimate + margin of error per cell. Table shells file gives labels.

variables_we_need: GEOID20, land area, water area, geometry
notes: No 2021/2022 ZCTA cartographic file exists; 2020 ZCTAs are the current vintage and match PLACES + ACS.
Used for mapping context and county assignment.
Used to assign each ZCTA to a state/county (largest land-area part) without a spatial join.

provider: US EPA (Safe Drinking Water Information System via Envirofacts)
variables_we_need: PWSID, PWS type, activity code, gw/sw code, owner type, population served count, service connections, city, ZIP
notes: UCMR5 has no population-served field; SDWIS supplies it. 100% match to UCMR5 Texas PWSIDs. Population-served is an administrative estimate.
county_served is a semicolon-joined county-name list; used for cross-checking geography.
